import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p=params
    return p[0]*np.sqrt(t) + p[1]*np.log(1+p[2]*A)*t + p[3]*A**p[4]*t**p[5] + p[6]*A**p[7]*np.exp(-p[8]*A)*t**p[9]
